prompt: Which revision to the design-level forecast follows both messages?
promptZh: 哪項調整符合兩封信對不同設計款式的預測原則？

options.text: Switch both Wave and Pier to their newer designs without adding volume.
options.zh: Wave 和 Pier 都改列新款，但不增加數量。
options.whyZh: Wave 已獲准換款；Pier 圓角款只是拍照用樣品，正式規劃仍是方角款。

options.text: Keep the square Pier and replace the projected high-back Wave with the low-back Wave.
options.zh: Pier 仍列方角款，Wave 則把原預測的高背款換成低背款。
options.whyZh: Wave 低背款取代高背款且首批數量不變；Pier 仍按要求規劃方角款。

options.text: Keep both Wave designs in the forecast while moving the Pier demand to the rounded design.
options.zh: 兩款 Wave 都列入，Pier 的需求則轉到圓角款。
options.whyZh: Wave 是取代，不是兩款並列；也不應因 Pier 索取樣品就轉移需求。

options.text: Keep the existing Wave demand and add a separate forecast for the rounded Pier.
options.zh: Wave 維持原預測，另把圓角 Pier 列入預測。
options.whyZh: Wave 必須換款，圓角 Pier 則沒有新增需求的依據。

explanationZh: Wave 低背款取代高背款且首批數量不變；Pier 仍按要求規劃方角款。

vocabulary.zh: 重新分配已預測的需求
vocabulary.note: 改一種設計去承接原數量，不等於把新舊款的需求相加。

evidence: If the new design would take the place of an item already on the forecast, reassign that demand / Do not move demand merely because Rowan has asked for a design sample. / For the Pier desk, Rowan requested a sample of the rounded version for a photograph. It has told us to plan for the square version. / She has retained the same opening quantity. / Mara told me to replace the planned high-back order with the low-back version.
